items.name: 03_morse_n1b
items.text: [somber] In 1825, the painter Samuel Morse was far from home when a letter came: his wife had died. [pause] By the time he got back… she had already been buried.

items.name: 07_arpa_n1b
items.text: October 29th, 1969. A student at UCLA tries to send one word to a computer three hundred and fifty miles away: [pause] “log in.”

items.name: 09_fin_n1b
items.text: [tenderly] In 1977, Ann Druyan called Carl Sagan to say she had found a Chinese song for the Golden Record. [pause] By the end of that call… they were engaged.
